I will depend on the rains because here in Shinyanga we farm mostly without irrigation, and this big intercropped plot is too large for costly inputs. I will keep to the seed I know and avoid chemical fertilizer and sprays, because they are expensive and not easy for me to manage. My household will work on the plot, but for a farm this size I will also need to hire labor for land preparation and weeding.
